current_public_wording: first-party control-plane UI constrained by SDK and management-session boundary audits; not claimed as formally verified
future_allowed_wording: admin control-plane security boundary with formally specified and mechanically checked authorization/session state-machine invariants
excluded_surfaces: end-user credential submission on the admin SPA

required_evidence.description: A separate admin UI assurance case defines the bounded security claim and out-of-scope browser/UI behaviour.
Admin route, action, authorization, dangerous-operation, and management-session state machine is formally specified.
Authorization/session invariants are mechanically checked using the selected modelling tool.
UI routes/actions are bound to OpenAPI and management-client contracts with CI drift gates.
Hosted stack evidence exercises the bounded admin UI security claim and remains runtime regression evidence, not the proof itself.
Product positioning uses bounded admin-security wording and does not imply formally verified React/browser/UI rendering.
Record Phase 3 internal admin UI assurance evidence separately from public claim activation.
